grounding.states: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada
grounding.from: The 24th and current prime minister of Canada is Mark Carney

grounding.states: Carney took office as prime minister on 14 March 2025

value.answer: Mark Carney. He took over on March 14, 2025, after Justin Trudeau's government collapsed, and he's still the PM as far as my check shows.
